name: neomycin + polymyxin b + pramoxine
purpose: Uses first aid to help prevent infection and for the temporary relief of pain in minor:  cuts  scrapes  burns
uses: Directions  adults and children 2 years of age and older:  clean the affected area  apply a small amount of this product (an amount equal to the surface area of the tip of a finger) on the area 1 to 3 times daily  may be covered with a sterile bandage  children 2 years or younger: consult with a doctor
otcwarn: Do not use  in the eyes  over large areas of the body  if you are allergic to any of the ingredients Stop use and ask a doctor if  condition persists or gets worse  rash or other allergic reaction develops  you need to use longer than 1 week
